title.zh: 卷一百二十七 載記第二十七 慕容德

proposal.before: Later at a banquet for his ministers, when the wine was warm he laughed and said, 'Though I am meager, I reverently face south to court the lords; not proud on high, anxious at my post by night; with whom among the ancients may I be compared?'
proposal.after: Later at a banquet for his ministers, when the wine was warm he laughed and said, 'Though I am meager, I conduct myself respectfully, face south, and receive the lords at court; not proud on high, anxious at my post by night; with whom among the ancients may I be compared?'
proposal.reason: 恭己南面而朝諸侯 depicts the south-facing ruler receiving the lords at court, not him courting them; the remaining inherited wording is not assessed by this focused repair.

context.zh: 以其妻段氏為皇后。
context.idiomatic: He named his consort Lady Duan empress.
context.literal: He made his wife Lady Duan empress.

context.zh: 建立學官，簡公卿已下子弟及二品士門二百人為太學生。
context.idiomatic: He founded an academy with two hundred students from elite families.
context.literal: He established schools, selecting two hundred sons of dukes and ministers down to second rank gentry households as academy students.

context.zh: 後因宴其群臣，酒酣，笑而言曰：「朕雖寡薄，恭己南面而朝諸侯，在上不驕，夕惕於位，可方自古何等主也？」
context.idiomatic: Later at a banquet for his ministers, when the wine was warm he laughed and said, 'Though I am meager, I reverently face south to court the lords; not proud on high, anxious at my post by night; with whom among the ancients may I be compared?'
context.literal: Later at a banquet for his ministers, when the wine was warm he laughed and said, 'Though I am meager, I reverently face south to court the lords; not proud on high, anxious at my post by night; with whom among the ancients may I be compared?'

context.zh: 其青州刺史鞠仲曰：「陛下中興之聖後，少康、光武之儔也。」
context.idiomatic: His Qingzhou governor Ju Zhong said, 'Your Majesty is a sagely restorer of the middle revival, the peer of Shaokang and Guangwu.'
context.literal: His Qingzhou governor Ju Zhong said, 'Your Majesty is a sagely restorer of the middle revival, the peer of Shaokang and Guangwu.'

context.zh: 德顧命左右賜仲帛千匹。
context.idiomatic: Murong De told his staff to award Ju Zhong a thousand bolts of silk.
context.literal: De ordered attendants to grant Zhong a thousand bolts of silk.

context.idiomatic: Murong De told his staff to award Ju Zhong a thousand bolts of silk.
context.literal: De ordered attendants to grant Zhong a thousand bolts of silk.

proposal.before: Earlier, De had welcomed his brother's son Chao from Chang'an; at this point he arrived.
proposal.after: Earlier, De had sought to bring his brother's son Chao from Chang'an; at this point Chao arrived.
proposal.reason: The later arrival should not become an earlier completed welcome. This pairs with the previously reviewed idiomatic wording without asserting a precise means of 迎.

context.zh: 雅之等頓首答曰：「幸蒙陛下天覆之恩，大造之澤，存亡繼絕，實在聖時，雖則萬隕，何以上報！」
context.idiomatic: Yazhi and the others bowed their heads to the ground and replied: “We have fortunately received Your Majesty’s heaven-covering grace and great creative favor, preserving the dying and continuing the cut off. Truly this lies in a sage age; even if we fell ten thousand times, how could we repay it above!”
context.literal: Yazhi and the others bowed their heads to the ground and replied: “We have fortunately received Your Majesty’s heaven-covering grace and great creative favor, preserving the dying and continuing the cut off. Truly this lies in a sage age; even if we fell ten thousand times, how could we repay it above!”

context.zh: 俄聞桓玄敗，德以慕容鎮為前鋒，慕容鐘為大都督，配以步卒二萬，騎五千，克期將發，而德寢疾，於是罷兵。
context.idiomatic: Soon they heard Huan Xuan was defeated; Murong De made Murong Zhen the vanguard and Murong Zhong supreme commander, assigning twenty thousand foot and five thousand horse with a set departure date, but Murong De fell ill and therefore halted the army.
context.literal: Soon they heard Huan Xuan was defeated; De made Murong Zhen vanguard and Murong Zhong supreme commander, pairing them with twenty thousand foot and five thousand horse, fixing a date to set out, but De took to bed ill, and therefore the army was halted.

context.zh: 初，德迎其兄子超于長安，及是而至。
context.idiomatic: De's nephew Murong Chao, whom De had earlier sought to bring from Chang'an, now arrived.
context.literal: Earlier, De had welcomed his brother's son Chao from Chang'an; at this point he arrived.

context.zh: 德夜夢其父曰：「汝既無子，何不早立超為太子，不爾，惡人生心。」
context.idiomatic: De dreamed at night his father said, 'You have no son; why not early establish Chao as crown prince—otherwise evil men will breed designs.'
context.literal: De dreamed at night his father said, 'You have no son; why not early establish Chao as crown prince—otherwise evil men will breed designs.'

context.zh: 寐而告其妻曰：「先帝神明所敕，觀此夢意，吾將死矣。」
context.idiomatic: Awake he told his wife, 'The late emperor's spirit commanded; looking at this dream's meaning, I am about to die.'
context.literal: Awake he told his wife, 'The late emperor's spirit commanded; looking at this dream's meaning, I am about to die.'

relatedPeople.mentionException: Inferred intermediary: Chao is De's 兄子.

value.en: Murong Chao's father (elder brother of Murong De)

proposal.before: Thereupon he issued an edict making Chao crown prince, amnestied the realm, and for sons continuing fathers raised each man's rank two grades.
proposal.after: Thereupon he issued an edict making Chao crown prince and granting an amnesty throughout the realm; sons succeeding their fathers were each granted two grades of rank.
proposal.reason: The rank grant does not require a prior rank; match the independently revised idiomatic field without asserting an increase.

context.idiomatic: Awake he told his wife, 'The late emperor's spirit commanded; looking at this dream's meaning, I am about to die.'
context.literal: Awake he told his wife, 'The late emperor's spirit commanded; looking at this dream's meaning, I am about to die.'

context.zh: 乃下書以超為皇太子，大赦境內，子為父後者人爵二級。
context.idiomatic: He issued an edict naming Murong Chao crown prince and granting a general amnesty throughout the realm; sons succeeding their fathers were each granted two grades of rank.
context.literal: Thereupon he issued an edict making Chao crown prince, amnestied the realm, and for sons continuing fathers raised each man's rank two grades.

context.zh: 其月死，即義熙元年也，時年七十。
context.idiomatic: He died the same month, in the first year of Yixi, at seventy sui.
context.literal: That month he died; it was the first year of Yixi, and at the time his age was seventy sui.

context.zh: 乃夜為十餘棺，分出四門，潛葬山谷，竟不知其屍之所在。
context.idiomatic: That night they prepared more than ten coffins and sent them out through the four gates, burying him secretly in the mountain valleys; in the end, no one knew where his body lay.
context.literal: That night they made more than ten coffins, sent them out the four gates separately, and secretly buried him in mountain valleys; in the end none knew where his corpse lay.
